rules.diagnosis_template: Very High Cohesion. The {module_name} module focuses on a single stage ({stage_name_1}) and contains no non-ML content.
rules.recommendation_template: Keep the module as it is and document it as a reference for future ML pipeline designs.

rules.diagnosis_template: High Cohesion. The {module_name} module contains a single phase ({phase_name}) but combines code from several stages ({stage_name_1}, {stage_name_2}) within that phase, with no non-ML content.
rules.recommendation_template: Maintain the module if it is small. If it is or becomes too large, consider splitting it by stage.

rules.diagnosis_template: Medium Cohesion. The {module_name} module combines code from several phases ({phase_name}) but contains no non-ML content.
rules.recommendation_template: Split the module into one module per phase if it is large or expected to grow significantly. If the resulting modules remain too large, consider further decomposing them into stage-specific modules.

rules.diagnosis_template: Medium Cohesion. The {module_name} module combines the code of a single stage ({stage_name_1}) with non-ML content.
rules.recommendation_template: Separate the non-ML content into a different module to isolate pipeline-related functionality from unrelated code and improve conceptual cohesion.

rules.diagnosis_template: Low Cohesion. The {module_name} module combines code from several stages ({stage_name_1}, {stage_name_2}) within a phase ({phase_name}) with non-ML content.
rules.recommendation_template: Separate at least the non-ML content into a different module. Additionally, split the module into one module per stage if its size increases.

rules.diagnosis_template: Very Low Cohesion. The {module_name} module combines code from several phases ({phase_name}) with non-ML content.
rules.recommendation_template: Separate at least the non-ML content into a different module. Additionally, split the module into one module per phase. If the resulting modules remain too large, further decompose them into stage-specific modules.
